name: overhead_ribbon
description: Drum overheads — ribbon mic (e.g. AEA R84, Royer R-121)
notes: Ribbons have a natural HF rolloff — the opposite of condensers. Can boost high shelf to add air/sparkle without harshness (ribbons don't distort the way condensers do). HP removes low-end bleed. No need to cut sizzle — ribbons don't have it.

filters._note: restore air ribbons naturally roll off
